title: AC1027 selected material and plotstyle graph strict DXF repeat conversion
problem: The preceding strict AC1027 generated output has LAYER 0 group 390 pointing to its Normal ACDBPLACEHOLDER. A second strict DXF conversion succeeds but replaces that handle with F, which has no corresponding object. It also registers a legacy DICTIONARYWDFLT class name for the canonical raw object.
authority: Autodesk ACDBDICTIONARYWDFLT DXF specifies AcDbDictionary cloning 281, soft-owner 350 and default hard pointer 340, without group 280: https://help.autodesk.com/cloudhelp/2020/ENU/AutoCAD-DXF/files/GUID-A6605C05-1CF4-42A4-95EC-42190B2424EE.htm. Existing source plot audit accepts absent 280 only with default soft ownership and no hard-owner entries.
source_binding: A separate optional, allocation-free CLASS source facet observes paired CLASS rows during the successful import without adding DRW_Interface slots or requiring whole-file observation. The selected strict route requires the exact three canonical CLASS names, flags and counts 3/1/1, no unknown groups and matching live rows. It joins the same-import raw/typed LAYER resource audit and canonical plotstyle source audit, exact root/group/material dictionary raw whitelists, exact known MATERIAL group sequence and unchanged imported raw/typed MATERIAL baselines. Canonical WDFLT marker is required. Staged TABLES verifies 347/390; staged OBJECTS checks all three root entries, 350/340 plot edges and placeholder owner; HEADER and material inspector/finalizers preserve CMATERIAL/347.
scope: Strict DXF AC1027 to DXF AC1027, exact one-layer default material/plotstyle graph produced by preceding AC1027 selected DWG output. Strict explicit non-F plot references outside this proof fail closed. In the shared read-only plot-source audit, other omitted-280 default-soft dictionaries can newly report source-ready, without gaining output authorization. Non-strict/direct callers retain the old F fallback; it is not target-closed. Typed/raw MATERIAL edits, other source shapes, versions and whole-file/native-CAD claims are outside this profile.
abi: DRW_Interface and installed model layouts stay unchanged. The optional source facet adds no existing virtual slot; in-tree dx_iface gains a polymorphic base and its binary layout changes, so external code linked against that internal adapter must rebuild.
validation: Fixture-free modified strict-graph selector generates its own input, executes two repeat cycles and cross-encoding readback, and tests source/live audit removal, target/role/owner/root/material/class edits, wrong output version and sentinel-preserving same-adapter retries. For ASCII and binary input it independently mutates all three CLASS counts, extra group 300, missing and duplicate rows; tests legacy object/class marker, 280-present/hard-owner role, dangling group 390, unknown LAYER/MATERIAL/root/group/material-dictionary fields; all refuse. Existing non-strict F fallback control stays unchanged. Pinned raw-tag/ezdxf graph auditor passes ASCII, Binary and Binary-to-ASCII results; same-encoding output hashes equal the preceding qualified output. Coherent scratch CMake build and all three listed CTests pass (3/3); this build is on original 03532664.
plan_delta: Record same-revision one-layer generated AC1027 strict DXF repeat with CLASS/source graph and 347/390/CMATERIAL closure; retain physical producer whole-document, other graph profiles, cross-revision output and native behavior as open.
integration_note: Integrated on top of 86326378; main-workspace build completed and the three listed focused CTests passed 3/3.
